The Liquid markup is complete and must stay unchanged. The single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block is outdated: the stat count is a text field and there is only one label instead of singular and plural labels. Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following. Top-level keys: - "name": "Rich text counts" - "tag": "section" - "class": "rich-text-counts-section" - "settings": the array described below - "blocks": the array described below - "max_blocks": 4 - "presets": the array described below Section settings, in this exact order: 1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "By the numbers". 2. type "richtext", id "text", label "Text", default "
